name: BSP_Localization_ParseTableFile
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Takes the manager in ECX plus an 8-byte native string by value and two ints on the stack. Collects every mount holding the name (00bdef90) and parses each stream. Record grammar from the three states of local_4f80: ASCII token to a space, second ASCII token to a space, then 16-bit units until the unit pair 0x0A00,0x0D00 (file bytes 00 0A 00 0D). The key is token1 + "." (00ce3a70) + token2 in a 152-byte stack buffer; the text is UTF-16LE in a 19994-byte buffer; neither is bounds-checked. Values go into the map through 00a9fc30, so a repeated key overwrites. When the second int argument is zero it then reads the same name with "x" appended (00ceb488), a flat array of 16-bit pairs appended to the vectors at manager +0x4020 and +0x4030. Validated against the installed lockit/englishauthentic.lan: 6864 records, 6864 terminators, whole file consumed. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_LOCALE.md; reports/app_init_locale.json.

name: BSP_Localization_ReloadTables
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = the localisation manager at 00f8bc4c, one char stack argument (force), RET 4. Loads when the map count at +0x4014 is zero or force is nonzero, otherwise returns at 00aa0952. Builds "lockit/" (00d5bcd0) + the stored language name at +0x4018 + ".lan" (00d5bcc8), parses it through 00aa0020, then probes the same path with the decimal suffixes 0..98 (004260b0 formats with %d) and stops at the first name BSP_VFS_ResolveExistingName rejects. Called at 0073e135 with force = 0 and at 008d5135 with force = 1. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_LOCALE.md; reports/app_init_locale.json.

name: BSP_Localization_LoadTable
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); analysis-only packet app_initialize_map, no reconstruction. Called at 0073e08f with a native string built from the value returned by 008d4870. References lockit/ and reaches 'Content file name for %s' and '<SRCH><'. Evidence: docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md; reports/app_initialize_map.json. | Packet app_init_locale: reconstructed. __thiscall, ECX = the manager at 00f8bc4c, one native-string pointer, RET 4. Early-outs at 00aa0a0a when 00435c40 finds the argument case-insensitively equal to the stored name at +0x4018; otherwise stores it, clears the map with 0073c240 on manager+0x14, and loads only when the registered-name vector at +8/+0xc is non-empty and the count at +0x4014 is zero. Path is lockit/ + name + .lan plus the decimal suffixes 0..98. The tail refreshes the GUI through 004c12b0 and 00aa4650. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_LOCALE.md.

name: BSP_Localization_RegisterTableName
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Two instructions: ADD ECX,4 then JMP 00450540, a push_back onto the vector of 8-byte native strings whose base/end/capacity are manager +8/+0xc/+0x10. Called at 0073e103 and 008d5101 with the literal "globals" (00cf7774), which is a category prefix present in the installed table (509 records). Duplicates are not filtered and the contents are never read by 00aa09d0 or 00aa06d0, which only test whether the vector is empty. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_LOCALE.md; reports/app_init_locale.json.

name: BSP_GuiManager_SetEnabled
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_blocking_screen_frame, read-only analysis. Provisional. __thiscall, ECX = the 0x88-byte cGuiManager, one byte stack argument, RET 4. Stores the argument at manager+0x48 (a byte the constructor 00aa5d70 zeroes) and, only when it is zero, tail-JMPs to the virtual +0x34 of manager+0x50 with the argument slot rewritten to 0. manager+0x50 is MousePtrFE_Icon (docs/APP_INIT_FONTS_GUI.md resource 4) and +0x34 is the visibility setter, so a disable also hides the front-end mouse pointer. The decompiler's jumptable warning at 00aa0e1b is the tail JMP. Nine call sites; in BSP_Game_OnMove 004e4c4d passes 0 and 004e4c5c passes 1 on the two halves of the branch on byte DAT_00f8abe8+0x3e8.

name: BSP_GuiManager_SetPointerVisible
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_blocking_screen_frame, read-only analysis. Provisional. Four instructions at 00aa0e50-00aa0e58: ECX = manager+0x50, then a bare JMP to that object's virtual +0x34 without pushing anything, so it forwards its own stack frame. All four call sites push one argument before fetching the manager (004e4c38 pushes 0, 00565081, 004daa9d and 004c6e1c likewise), which makes the real signature __thiscall f(cGuiManager*, bool) with the callee cleaning the argument; Ghidra's zero-argument __fastcall signature and its jumptable warning at 00aa0e58 are both artefacts of the tail JMP. manager+0x50 is MousePtrFE_Icon. Unlike BSP_GuiManager_SetEnabled it never touches manager+0x48.

name: BSP_GuiManager_ResetScreens
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall f(manager): for the two non-null objects at manager+0x74 and manager+0x78 it writes the triple (-1.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f) into a local (00d7a260 holds 0xBF800000), passes it to the position setter 00aa8240 with the screen in ECX, then calls the screen virtual slot +0x34 with argument 0. The mechanics are from the listing at 00aa0f70; reading slot +0x34 as close or hide is unverified.

name: BSP_GuiLayout_WidgetTypeForKey
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = key string), RET. Takes the substring after the last '_' (004BCB80 with 00CE7890), or the whole key when there is none, and __stricmp chains it against seventeen literals: Icon 6, Text 3, Group 2, Progbar 5, Line 4, Scrollbar 7, Grid 8, Model 9, Movie 10, Listbox 0Bh, AnimIcon 0Ch, Curve 0Dh, Sound 0Eh, Button 0Fh, ClipBox 10h, Section 11h, FrameBox 12h. Returns 0 for a property key. Sole caller 00AAA710. See docs/GUI_LAYOUT_LOADER.md.

name: BSP_GUI_ResolveTextureAndAtlasUV
evidence: stdcall filename string pointer, float[4] inout UV, float[2] inout size, float scale; RET10h; EAX referenced texture. Reads atlas floatUV+14h..20h, preserves negative U/V extent flips. Both size components zero -> unsigned texture dimensions and absUV extent scaled by960/720. Retains atlas texture; miss renderer+64h load leaves UV/size unchanged. Typed callback port implemented; installedatlas mirror, bothzeroautosize, reference/fallback anddraw checked; docs/ATLAS_GEOMETRY.md. Win32 x87 helper preserves dimension/difference float32 spills and mul/div/mul order; FPflags/nativeABI unverified.

name: BSP_GuiManager_FindPageByName

name: BSP_GuiManager_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. Provisional. Four callers; in BSP_Game_OnMove it is called only immediately after BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate (004e4b67 on the blocking-screen fast path, 004e4cb8 on the front-end path), with the raw frame delta and a zero second argument, and immediately before BSP_Game_Render. | Packet game_blocking_screen_frame: __thiscall, ECX = the 0x88-byte cGuiManager, stack arguments float seconds then a byte flag, RET 8; both BSP_Game_OnMove call sites pass flag 0. Body: byte manager+0x70 = flag; if flag == 0, 00aa3910(manager) runs the pointer hit-test pass over the cursor vector at DAT_00f8bbf4+0x94; BSP_GuiManager_ResetScreens (00aa0f70) hides hl_FrameBox at +0x74 and hlCircle_FrameBox at +0x78; 004d35d0 copy-constructs a temporary vector from the screen vector at manager+0x18/+0x1c so the walk is over a snapshot; each element is updated through its virtual +0x40(seconds) when its virtual +0x38 returns non-zero or BSP_GuiScreen_HasLiveEntries does; on exit manager+0x70 is cleared unconditionally and the snapshot is freed. The interleaved 00bf6713 calls are _SECURE_SCL assertions.

name: BSP_GuiManager_RegisterPageByPriority
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = GUI manager, GuiScreen *page), RET 4. After 00AA30C0(page) it inserts into the std::vector<GuiScreen*> at manager +14h (begin +18h, end +1Ch, capacity +20h) before the first entry whose +FCh is strictly greater, so the single page list stays sorted by the 'Priority' key ascending and equal priorities keep insertion order. No separate layer container exists. Called by 00AA5840 and 00AC59A0. See docs/GUI_LAYOUT_LOADER.md.

name: BSP_GuiManager_LoadPage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = GUI manager, const NativeString *name, int screen_flag, char add_reference), RET 0Ch, body 00AA5840-00AA59A9. Looks the name up with 00AA3140 and returns the existing page, raising page+4h through 00CE221C when add_reference is set. Otherwise builds '<name>.mmod' (00D0E67C), probes the VFS singleton 0109CEEC, instantiates the model through 004C1400/00B80D70 and vtable +8h(0, 1.0f) storing it at manager+30h, or allocates 188h via 00B8F450 when the name is absent; then allocates 124h via 00AC51A0, runs the GuiScreen constructor 00AC6600, and registers with 00AA52A0. See docs/GUI_LAYOUT_LOADER.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_CollectSortedChildren
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = an out std::vector, EDX = widget). Copies the payload dword of each node of the widget's child list at +68h into the vector, then calls 00AA4E00 with the element count. Sole caller 00AAAED0. It is NOT a descriptor reader, correcting the gui_layout_loader packet premise. See docs/GUI_LAYOUT_LOADER.md.

name: BSP_GuiManager_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall f(void *this) returning this, RET, body 00aa5d70-00aa5e18, sole caller 004c12b0 BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate. Vtable 00d5bfcc. Stores a node from 00aa2920 at +0xc, sets its byte +0x15 to 1 and self-links its +0/+4/+8 pointers as a sentinel; zeroes +0x10 and +0x18..+0x30; stores 00aa2820's result at +0x38; zeroes +0x3c, +0x40, byte +0x48 and +0x6c; copies the float DAT_00ce3800 into +0x5c and +0x60. It leaves +0x4c, +0x50, +0x54, +0x58 and +0x74..+0x84 uninitialised, exactly the fields 00aa5e20 fills, which is the ordering evidence that the resource load must run once after construction. The segment-76 literal cGuiManager is the only direct name support. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_FONTS_GUI.md; reports/app_init_fonts_gui.json.

name: BSP_GuiManager_LoadResources
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall f(void *this), ECX = the 0x88-byte GUI manager, RET, body 00aa5e20-00aa633e. Sole caller 0073bae0 at 0073bc20. Loads a fixed ten-entry resource list: data/interface/textures/whiteGui.tga (00d5c084) into +0x28 behind a BSP_VFS_ResolveExistingName gate at 00aa5e88 and interface/textures/common/transparent.tga (00d5c058) into +0x2c, both through renderer *(00f8d394) virtual +0x64; then group _Mouse (00d5c050) via 00aa5840 into +0x4c, children MousePtrFE_Icon (00d5c040) into +0x54 and +0x50 and MousePtrGUI_Icon (00d5c02c) into +0x58 via 00aa7e00 with ECX = [+0x4c]; then group _Highlight (00d5c020) via 00aa5840 kept only in EDI, and children hl_FrameBox, hlCircle_FrameBox, safezone_43_FrameBox and safezone_169_FrameBox into +0x74, +0x78, +0x7c and +0x80 with ECX = that group. 00aa5840 always takes the manager, 00aa7e00 always takes a group. Each widget is followed by a virtual +0x34(bool); MousePtrFE_Icon's is deferred to 00aa60a3, after MousePtrGUI_Icon's. Byte +0x84 is cleared last at 00aa6305. Six blocks are reported unreachable by the decompiler, so the literals were read from the listing. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_FONTS_GUI.md; reports/app_init_fonts_gui.json.

name: BSP_GuiLayout_CreateWidgetOfType
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = type id, EDX = object or 0), RET. Switch over the ids 00AA2490 produces. Case targets and the ECX size immediate each loads at stub+19h: 1 00AA3BD0 124h (page root), 2 00AA12F0 0ECh, 3 00AA1380 1F4h, 4 00AA1530 104h, 5 00AA14A0 140h, 6 00AA1410 138h, 7 00AA15C0 0FCh, 8 00AA1650 124h, 9 00AA16E0 11Ch, 0Ah 00AA1770 130h, 0Bh the factory singleton 00F8BC10 via 00A9B7E0 then 00A9DF40 (EDX zero) or 00AA5B40 (EDX non-zero), 0Ch 00AA2340 144h, 0Dh 00AA1800 140h, 0Eh 00AA1890 108h, 0Fh 00AA4440 0FCh, 10h 00AA1920 10Ch, 11h 00AA19B0 12Ch, 12h 00AA1A40 11Ch. Default 0. 00AAA710 always passes EDX = 0. See docs/GUI_LAYOUT_LOADER.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_CreateWithSceneNode
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = type_tag, EDX = const char* node_name, stack: void* ctor_arg) -> widget in EAX, RET 4, SEH handler 00cb7368. 00AA665D builds the widget through the type factory 00AA6560; 00AA6669 allocates 0x184 bytes through 00B74EB0 and 00AA6681 runs the node constructor 00B75030 with the name; 00AA6695 binds the node through 00AA6720; 00AA66A1 dispatches the widget's virtual +74h. The only node-creation site for a widget that is not a clone. Evidence in docs/GUI_WIDGET_SCENE_VISIBILITY.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetSceneNode
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, void* node), RET 4, four instructions: stores the node at widget+4Ch and, when it is non-null, clears the low two bits of the node's flag word at node+138h with AND FFFFFFFCh. The copy constructor clears the same two bits after its own bind at 00AA9705. Evidence in docs/GUI_WIDGET_SCENE_VISIBILITY.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_GetSize
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget) RET, the two instructions LEA EAX,[ECX+20h]; RET. A GUI widget stores its size as two floats at +20h and +24h; 00683380 reads +4h of the result as the thumb height and 006834A0 reads +0h as its width. 97 callers. docs/FRONTEND_SCREEN_ANIMATION.md. | The pair is the Size property: the descriptor table at 00AAAED0 binds widget+20h to the literal Size (00cff278). Its setter is virtual slot +58h, 00AA7970. Base vtable 00d5bbf8.

name: x
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, Vec3* out) -> out in EAX, RET 4. When the parent pointer at +70h is non-null it recurses to the parent's resolved position and applies the parent's scale pair at +18h/+1Ch times its size pair at +20h/+24h before adding the widget's own local translation at +0Ch..+14h; the Z term goes through FSUB double [00D7A258] which is 0.0. 92 callers. docs/FRONTEND_SCREEN_ANIMATION.md. | Correction from docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md: the pair at +18h/+1Ch is Pivot, not scale. The descriptor table at 00AAAED0 binds +18h to the literal Pivot (00d5c228), +20h to Size (00cff278) and +28h to Scale (00ce60ac), and the base constructor 00AA9390 leaves +18h/+1Ch at 0 while it sets +28h/+2Ch to 1.0. Scale takes no part in the parent chain. Exact order at 00AA675F..00AA67BD: the parent pivot offset (size lane loaded, pivot multiplied in) is computed first, then the recursion, then (parent_resolved + own_position) reaches the frame, and only then is the pivot offset subtracted; folding the subtraction in earlier is a different float result. Z subtracts the 0.0 double at 00d7a258.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetVisibilityRecursive
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, char recurse), RET 4, three instructions writing widget+75h. That byte is the third argument 00AA8530 hands to 00B6DA70 at 00AA8581 and 00AA8598 and the fourth argument it seeds 00AA8450 with, so it decides whether a visibility change stamps the whole node subtree or only this node. Default 0 from 00AA9466. Evidence in docs/GUI_WIDGET_SCENE_VISIBILITY.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetAlpha
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, float alpha), RET 4. Base vtable 00d5bbf8 slot +4Ch, the slot the front-end scroll block drives with 0.2, 0.25 and 1.0. Stores the argument at widget+5Ch, the alpha lane of the four-float Color property at +50h..+5Ch (00ce93f8, default 1,1,1,1 from 00AA9390), then walks the scene node at +4Ch through 00b74650, 00b74640(0), 00b72b40, 00b74640(0,0), 00b732c0, [+20h] and 00b179f0(0) and writes the same float at +0Ch of the result. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetActive
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, char), RET 4, three instructions: MOV AL,[ESP+4]; MOV [ECX+85h],AL. Base of widget vtable +60h. Sole writer of +85h; the only readers are 00A9D048, where the per-frame update refuses to run while it is clear, and 00A9CA90, where a navigation target must have it set. Both are in the segment-75 control class, so Active is provisional. Evidence in docs/GUI_WIDGET_SCENE_VISIBILITY.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_RefreshLocalBounds
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget), RET. Returns immediately unless the byte at +74h is set (00AA70E6). Otherwise it reaches the render object through the scene node at widget+4Ch with 00b74640(0,0) then 00b732c0, and calls 00b855b0 with a four-float frame block at ESP+0Ch: size.x*0.5, size.y*0.5, 0.0 and 0.5*max(size.x,size.y), a half-extent triple plus a radius. The 0.5 is the double at 00d7a280; the max keeps the height on a tie (00AA7132..00AA714E). Callers: 00AA7170, 00AA7D00, 00AA7D40, 00AA7D80, 00AA7DC0, 00AA8240, 00AA8710, 00AAB4C0. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_DeactivateAndRefreshBounds
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget), RET, nine instructions. 00AA7175 dispatches virtual +60h with the single argument 0 (base 00AA6A30 stores it at widget+85h) and 00AA717F is a tail jump into 00AA70E0. Widget vtable +78h in table 00d5bed0. Not a visibility change. Evidence in docs/GUI_WIDGET_SCENE_VISIBILITY.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_RecomposeLocalTransform
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget), RET. Builds four row-major 4x4 matrices in its 1DCh-byte frame and multiplies them with 00413920 (left*right, RET 8, EAX=destination): pivot translate M3 = T(-(pivot.x at +18h)*(size.x at +20h), ((-(pivot.y at +1Ch))*(size.y at +24h))*0.75, 0) at ESP+58h; scale M2 = diag(+28h, +2Ch, 1, 1) at ESP+18h; RotZ from 00b64780 with the single float -0.0f-(rotate at +48h); translate M1 = T(pos.x at +0Ch, (pos.y at +10h)*0.75, pos.z at +14h) at ESP+98h. The chain is ((M3*M2)*RotZ)*M1 and the result goes to the scene node at widget+4Ch through its vtable +38h (00AA745C). The 0.75 is the float at 00e12fc4 and reaches the Y lanes only. 18 callers, all widget field setters plus 00AA8240 and 00AA8710. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetLocalX
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, float x), RET 4. MOVSS the argument to widget+0Ch, then CALL 00AA7220. Transform only; the bounding volume is not refreshed. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetLocalY
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, float y), RET 4. MOVSS the argument to widget+10h, then CALL 00AA7220. Transform only. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetLocalZ
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, float z), RET 4. MOVSS the argument to widget+14h, then CALL 00AA7220. Transform only; 00AA7D40 is the variant that also refreshes bounds. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetRotate
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, float radians), RET 4. MOVSS the argument to widget+48h, the Rotate property of the descriptor table at 00AAAED0 (00d5c220), then CALL 00AA7220, which negates it into the Z rotation builder 00b64780. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetScale
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, const float pair[2]), RET 4. Copies the two floats to widget+28h/+2Ch, the Scale property (00ce60ac, default 1,1 from 00AA9390), then CALL 00AA7220 where the pair becomes the diagonal of the scale matrix. Scale plays no part in the parent chain in 00AA6750. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetSize
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, const float pair[2]), RET 4. Base vtable 00d5bbf8 slot +58h, the slot the front-end scroll block drives with a two-float pair. Copies the two floats to widget+20h/+24h with x87 loads and stores, then calls 00AA7220. It does not refresh the bounding volume, so a resize leaves the node's bounds stale until some other path calls 00AA70E0. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetLocalXYAndBounds
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, float x, float y), RET 8. Writes +0Ch and +10h from the two stack floats and rewrites +14h with its own value, then calls 00AA7220 and 00AA70E0. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetLocalZAndBounds
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, float z), RET 4. Rewrites +0Ch and +10h with their own values, writes the argument to +14h, then calls 00AA7220 and 00AA70E0. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetAuthoredX
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, float x), RET 4. Rewrites +0Ch..+14h with their own values, calls 00AA7220 and 00AA70E0, and only then MOVSS the argument to widget+8h. +8h is the authored X that the wide-screen layout pass 00AA8710 recomputes +0Ch from on every pass, so writing +0Ch alone does not survive a relayout. Neither callee reads +8h, so the store order is not observable. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetLocalPositionAndBounds
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, const float xyz[3]), RET 4. Copies the three floats to +0Ch..+14h with SSE moves, then calls 00AA7220 and 00AA70E0. Unlike 00AA8240 it writes the local translation directly, without the parent chain. docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_FindChildByName
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = widget, const NativeString *name, int unused), RET 8, body 00AA7E00-00AA7EAE. Walks the widget's direct children only (list at +68h, sentinel +64h), skips any child whose scene node at +4Ch is null, reads the node name through 00B6D800 and compares length then __stricmp. Returns the child or 0. The second stack argument (callers pass 1) is popped by RET 8 but never read, so this is NOT recursive and NOT a factory, correcting docs/APP_INIT_FONTS_GUI.md and docs/LOADING_SCREEN_ELEMENTS.md. See docs/GUI_LAYOUT_LOADER.md.

name: BSP_GuiScreen_HasLiveEntries
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_blocking_screen_frame, read-only analysis. Provisional. __fastcall, ECX = a cGuiScreen, no arguments, returns AL. Scans the screen+0x8c dword-counted array of pointers at screen+0x88 and returns 1 at the first non-null element, 0 otherwise. Its only observed use is in BSP_GuiManager_Update at 00aa500c, as the fallback that makes a screen whose virtual +0x38 said no still receive its virtual +0x40 update, so the array holds work that must drain even while the screen is not being drawn.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_SetResolvedPosition
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget, const Vec3*) RET 4, the inverse of 00AA6750: it calls 00AA6750 on the same parent basis and writes the difference back into the widget's local translation at +0Ch. 78 callers. docs/FRONTEND_SCREEN_ANIMATION.md. | Correction and completion from docs/GUI_WIDGET_TRANSFORM.md: +18h/+1Ch is Pivot, not scale (descriptor table 00AAAED0 binds it to 00d5c228). Order at 00AA8275..00AA82B5: (world - parent_resolved) reaches the frame first, then the parent pivot offset is added back, the exact inverse of 00AA6750. With no parent (00AA82E1) the argument is stored to +0Ch..+14h with SSE moves. Both paths then call 00AA7220 (recompose) and 00AA70E0 (bounds) with ECX = the widget.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_ReleaseSceneNodes
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(widget), RET, widget vtable +20h in both tables. 00AA8325 walks the children in list order calling each child's own vtable +20h; 00AA8372 dispatches vtable +0Ch with the class descriptor 00AB6A30 returns from 00f8be28 and calls 00AB73B0 on a match; 00AA8380 unlinks and releases the node at +4Ch through 00B6DFA0 and clears the field, so a second call is a no-op. Called by the destructor 00AA9730 and by 00ACC6A0. Evidence in docs/GUI_WIDGET_SCENE_VISIBILITY.md.

name: BSP_GuiWidget_DetachChild
